name: istanbul-live-seismic
description: İSTANBUL LIVE SEISMIC — İstanbul'un canlı sismik hareketlerini izleyin.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ils/api" "npm run dev -w @ils/web"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @ils/api" "npm run dev -w @ils/worker" "npm run dev -w @ils/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @ils/api" "npm run start -w @ils/web"
